ar_body: في اختبارات مع باحثي Wiz وجد Gemini 4 Argon ضعف عدد الثغرات مقارنة بالنماذج الأساسية.
body: In shadow A/B testing on real-world systems, Wiz security researchers put Gemini 4 Argon to the test against complex cyber threats. Using its advanced reasoning and long-horizon capabilities, Gemini 4 Argon found over two times more vulnerabilities than baseline models and successfully uncovered critical risks—such as identifying a file download bypass and master key in healthcare software. By handling tireless, multi-step threat analysis and remediation, Gemini 4 gives defenders the crucial advantage needed to outpace attackers and protect sensitive data faster than ever before.
